title: Rovers on Mars
subtitle: 考点：行星探测 / rover, mission, operate
passage: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun, and it is often called the Red Planet. People have not set foot on it yet, but robots called rovers have explored it. A rover is a small vehicle with wheels, cameras and tools. It moves slowly across the ground and sends pictures and information back to Earth.

A rover's mission is to find out whether life ever existed on Mars. Scientists on Earth operate the rover by radio signals. Because Mars is very far away, the signals take several minutes to arrive, so the rover cannot be controlled in real time. It must also work alone in cold, dusty places. Each new rover gives us more knowledge about our neighbour in space, and one day it may help to prepare for a trip by human beings.
